prompt: Production sprite sheet for an atmospheric, slightly abandoned 2D pixel-art neighborhood RPG. Industrial backstreet entrance integrated into a modest grey masonry wall with olive patina. Front OPEN shutter rolled neatly in a dark horizontal hood above an open doorway, narrow rusty steel tracks and worn concrete sill, shadowed empty interior. Front CLOSED identical surround with weathered dark desaturated teal slatted shutter down. SIDE entrance seen as high cutaway of a vertical wall: masonry pier at north and south, thin guide channels, horizontal short concrete threshold into building on LEFT. OPEN leaves an empty dark passage across the middle. CLOSED shows a slim north-south shutter edge blocking horizontal passage.
